rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Shasta's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s739_shasta_2026-11-26_s739b.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.option_lists_read_apart: An option the catalog prints takes more than one list under the option's own printed figure, and the record's one option group holds each list as an alternative of its own, so the program's units cannot be checked against the printed figures.

held.why: held: not the program's own: its blocks are the 'Emphasis in Coastal Science Technician' that 18626's record prints under the Geosciences Technician degree, it places 5 of its 16 listed courses, and its own note puts its heading on the preceding page, which the read did not hold: a page read that finds its own section

held: its 23-27 sits inside the printed 22-27 and units_within_printed_range is true of its figures, but its section is not shown to be its own: its heading sits on the page before the one the read held, and 18094 (University Studies - Physical Education), read from the same PDF page, holds 29 of its 32 courses in the same unit band. A read that holds page 99 with page 100 (a reread)

records.words: Earth Sciences University Studies – 20-22 Unit Emphasis: SC Program: AA.1515

program.section_heading: Earth Sciences University Studies – 20-22 Unit Emphasis: SC Program: AA.1515
outcomes: Demonstrate the interrelated aspects of our natural world through feedback loops across subsystems such as hydrosphere- atmosphere, atmosphere- biosphere, hydrosphere-atmosphere-biosphere connections or any of the planet's subsystems.

Explain life's connection to the abiotic world through the inclusion of evolution/natural selection and concepts in ecology/environmental quality and relate the dependence of life and the diversity of life to the abiotic world.
Use the intersection of the hydrosphere, atmosphere and geosphere to define how they support the biosphere noting habitat qualities reliant on each within that intersection.
Understand physical process that shape Earth's surface and the influence this has upon various aspects of the Earth system, including the anthrosphere.
Identify natural negative feedback loops in the Earth system and how one might be interrupted, or reversed to become a positive feedback loops, while including impacts to the global ecosystem.

live_run_proof.how: the hosting API's commits by path on main

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
